refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Import is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Import
# Describes the class of images type ImageClass( # An image to boot as a system on baremetal, in a VM or as a container machine, # An portable service image portable, # A system extension image sysext, # A configuration extension image confext )
# Describes the type of a images to transfer type RemoteType( # Raw binary disk images, typically in a GPT envelope raw, # A tarball, optionally compressed tar )
# Describes the type of a transfer type TransferType( # A local import of a tarball import_tar, # A local import of a raw disk image import_raw, # A local import of a file system tree import_fs, # A local export of a tarball export_tar, # A local export of a raw disk image export_raw, # A download of a tarball pull_tar, # A download of a raw disk image pull_raw )
# Describes whether and how thoroughly to verify the download before installing it locally type ImageVerify( # No verification no, # Verify that downloads match checksum file (SHA256SUMS), but do not check signature of checksum file checksum, # Verify that downloads match checksum file (SHA256SUMS), and check signature of checksum file. signature )
# Structure for log messages associated with a transfer operation type LogMessage( # The log message message: string, # The priority of the log message, using the BSD syslog priority levels priority: int )
# List ongoing transfers, or query details about specific transfers # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListTransfers( # Image class to filter by class: ?ImageClass ) -> ( # A unique numeric identifier for the ongoing transfer id: int, # The type of transfer type: TransferType, # The remote URL remote: string, # The local image name local: string, # The class of the image class: ImageClass, # Progress in percent percent: float )
# Download a .tar or .raw file. This must be called with the 'more' flag enabled. It will immediately return the numeric ID of the transfer, and then follow up with progress and log message updates, until the transfer is complete. # [Supports 'more' flag] method Pull( # The remote URL to download from remote: string, # The local image name to download to local: ?string, # The type of the resource type: RemoteType, # The image class class: ImageClass, # The whether and how thoroughly to verify the download before installing it locally. Defaults to 'signature'. verify: ?ImageVerify, # If true, an existing image by the local name is deleted. Defaults to false. force: ?bool, # Whether to make the image read-only after downloading. Defaults to false. readOnly: ?bool, # Whether to keep a pristine copy of the download separate from the locally installed image. Defaults to false. keepDownload: ?bool, # Root directory for images. If not specified derived from the image class, and located below /var/lib/. imageRoot: ?string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # A progress update, as percent value progress: ?float, # A log message about the ongoing transfer log: ?LogMessage, # The numeric ID of this download id: ?int )
# A transfer for the specified file is already ongoing error AlreadyInProgress( # The URL of the transfer already in progress. remote: string )
# The transfer has been cancelled on user request error TransferCancelled()
# The transfer failed error TransferFailed()
# No currently ongoing transfer error NoTransfers()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Import shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Import.ListTransfers '{}' invokes its ListTransfers() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Import interface was added in version 257.
AlreadyInProgress, ImageClass, ImageVerify, ListTransfers(), LogMessage, NoTransfers, Pull(), RemoteType, TransferCancelled, TransferFailed, and TransferType were added in version 257.
